title: Rapid Screening for Cardiovascular Risk
one_liner: A high-sensitivity triage tool using 7 objective 'hard indicators' to predict heart disease. We achieved 73% recall, turning simple health data into immediate, life-saving clinical insights.
problem: Traditional cardiovascular risk assessments often rely on subjective patient surveys or time-consuming laboratory tests that can delay life-saving triage.
approach: We identify a set of seven objective, verifiable data points that can be gathered in under 60 seconds to provide immediate clinical triage.
tradeoffs: Unlike standard models that aim for raw accuracy, our tool is optimized for clinical triage, ensuring that we catch as many at-risk individuals as possible

title: Lighthouse 3: Strategic Intelligence Advisor
one_liner: An autonomous high-reasoning agent that filters the noise of the AI market to deliver verified, ROI-focused strategic briefings directly to C-Suite executives.
problem: Executives today are drowning in 'AI noise' and need a trusted advisor to distill actionable insights.
approach: Lighthouse 3 performs deep-dive 'Intelligence Hunts' to produce professional-grade strategic briefings rendered through a minimalist web portal.
tradeoffs: No fancy bells & whistles here, this is built on a 'Lean Executive' architecture designed for speed and reliability.

title: Explainable Survival: From Prediction to Trust in Hex
one_liner: Local modeling, error analysis, and explainability work supporting an interactive ML app built in Hex.
problem: Just predicting survival on the Titanic dataset doesn't generate explainable results.
approach: This project reframes the classic Titanic survival prediction problem as a trust, error analysis, and interpretability challenge...
tradeoffs: This project was not about producing a Titanic leaderboard 'winner'...

title: The House of Westmarch: A Multi-Agent Concierge Estate of Dubious Decorum
one_liner: A quartet of aristocratic companions who attend to your affairs—planning, inquiry, drafting, critique—with charm and dignified commotion.
problem: Making agents remember details from previous interactions is challenging.
approach: This project defines a set of four distinct agents, each with their own personality and expertise...
tradeoffs: Interactions are meant to be light-hearted and entertaining rather than strictly utilitarian...
